history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the policies on rosters, taking into consideration geographic diversity, gender parity and sunset clauses, to ensure rightsizing based on workforce planning forecasts, clarify accountability for maintaining rosters and formulate guidance for hiring managers on selecting rostered candidates.
history.administration_response: The Department of Operational Support is working with the Office of Human Resources and the Staff- Management Committee on changes to roster management, which are currently under discussion with staff representatives and will require changes to the policy on the staff selection system. In the meantime, as part of efforts to streamline the roster under the current policy, a clean-up exercise of the regular rosters is being implemented by asking all rostered candidates to confirm whether they wish to remain on the roster. If they respond in the negative or do not indicate their preference, then their roster membership will be automatically placed on hold until they apply for jobs similar to those for which they were on the roster. Outreach activities are being devised by the Human Resources Services Division, with the aim of attracting as many qualified candidates from unrepresented and underrepresented Member States and qualified women as possible. Upon successful completion of the staff selection process, they will be placed on the roster, thereby contributing to greater geographical representation and gender balance on rosters.
history.board_assessment: Given that changes to roster management are currently under discussion, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
